$comment: HIGH/CRITICAL npm advisories that scripts/npm-audit-check.mjs lets through. Each must have a row in docs/security/npm-audit.md. Moderate/low advisories never gate CI and are documented there only.

exceptions.reason: No $async JSON Schema validators in any route. Fix needs fastify 5.
No route declares a headers schema. Fix needs fastify 5.
No route uses a boolean `false` schema. Fix needs fastify 5.
No Content-Type-keyed body schemas; state writes are re-validated by strict zod schemas. Fix needs fastify 5.
One root not-found handler, no encapsulated ones and no preHandler; auth is a global onRequest hook. Fix needs fastify 5.
HTTP/2 is never enabled. Fix needs fastify 5.
No route guard protects static files; it serves only the public web bundle (wildcard: false). Fix needs fastify 5.
Optional nodejs-whisper -> shelljs -> fast-glob chain; patterns are server-built temp paths. No fixed braces release.
